summary: Installed the three accepted PDFs and the reviewed canonical web edition and wired the publication; all five terminal gate checks exit 0 in this tree. The artifact snapshot was confirmed current before installation (--phase artifacts exit 0), then `make install-doc DOC=<id> PROVIDER=claude` was run once per output with no suppression (-o, -t, timestamp or dependency edits) and no change to an accepted source or its generation timestamp. Make retypeset the concise study and the homily and left the canonical study alone; both rebuilds were byte-identical, so every build PDF and every installed PDF hashes to its accepted value: the 38-page study a5705241a178bc453e6a93c23f9f6e9201faac8630361470830e51b839dc05d5 (303,195 bytes), the 12-page concise study 126bf160fb5de7e936399c24396d8bc93b46126e736e5f2d0b0a348591959dd7 (241,258 bytes) and the 5-page homily 923fb4936d107d3dec13fc6cf1b7a9197aed5dbb1ef19ae20cc5bb8f2d2fb289 (149,581 bytes). No hash differs, so no artifact defect is reported upstream. The retypeset itself exposed a build-graph defect and I am reporting it rather than absorbing it: REGISTER_PROPER_DERIVED_SOURCES globs *.toml anywhere beneath the leaf, so evaluations/blocking-findings-v1.toml, written at 04:29:36 by the web review, is a prerequisite of the -synthesis and -homily PDFs though no document renders from it, while REGISTER_DOCUMENT_SOURCES (render extensions only) left the canonical study up to date. All 25 render_inputs, both sealed .aux files and the study .log are byte-identical; the sole byte-level consequence was the concise .log's pdfTeX banner clock (line 1, 03:32 -> 04:33, every other line identical and both clean), which is a sealed member of pagination_evidence. I restored the reviewed log bytes retained by this run at build/tpt-runs/1e02dc05f2df9940/artifacts/build-artifacts-0002/57-seventeenth-after-pentecost-synthesis.log (8622156d7f5376a23ef9b6614563c0a16e8fc61dfc076547673aae2b8789be27, the digest the snapshot records), keeping the post-install log in this stage's scratch area; no receipt was rewritten to absorb the difference and research/artifacts.json is untouched, so the visual seal is true rather than refreshed. The durable fix belongs in the Makefile's derived-source glob, since a .log banner cannot survive any retypeset. build/web/claude/.../57-seventeenth-after-pentecost.md was copied byte for byte to web/claude/.../57-seventeenth-after-pentecost.md (115,834 bytes, 45132c6a78f9c7000d84cd966fb8803de848e6cefa826456457133de0222eb95, cmp clean) and staged, so git ls-files proves it tracked; no synthesis or homily web leaf exists. Three release records were created with make add-publication at status alpha against library/traditional-latin-mass.md, none pre-existing and none overwritten, each naming schema 1, its exact output id and the standing authorization perpetual-public-repository-2026. Row 57's Claude cell went from Planned to the three PDFs and the canonical web page in the manifest's declared label order (Full PDF, Synthesis PDF, Homily PDF, Read), with the ChatGPT cell, all other rows and cycles untouched and no companion row added; one canonical marker claude:liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/57-seventeenth-after-pentecost was added, prefixed because release/public-alpha.json names gpt primary. tools/tpt document-library structure regenerated the projection with every change confined to work 94 (gpt edition byte-for-byte intact at index 1, claude edition added with both companions, web page and this run's produced identity), one of 142 works differing. The release refresh was scoped to the three paths this stage changed (ADOPT=1 ONLY=catalog, web edition, corpus.json), five changes, nothing of a sibling's adopted. Installation facts and the build-graph defect are recorded in research/production-review.md. Gate checks run here: --phase publication, make check-release-bindings (0 stale), tools/tpt public-alpha check (scoped policy valid, 221 publications), document-library check plus structure --check (current), make check-web-editions-current (match) - all exit 0. Nothing committed.
